title: Anthropic S-1 Shows Founders Can Revoke Pledge to Donate 80% of Equity
summary: The leadership of AI startup Anthropic may retain their ownership stakes in the company despite a prior commitment to give them away. A disclosure in the company's S-1 filing states that the founders' pledge to donate 80% of their personal equity is non-binding and revocable.
